Plugin.Name: Share Name Normalizer
Plugin.Overview: Previews and bulk-renames Unraid user shares so capital letters become lowercase and spaces become hyphens (e.g. "TV Shows" -> "tv-shows"). Shows a full preview before making changes, refuses batches with name collisions, requires the array started and Docker/VMs/mover stopped, creates a flash-drive backup, and attempts automatic rollback if a rename fails.
